desc:
Test your skill on randomly selected floors from hundreds of towers across your favorite fangames. Beat each floor before the timer runs out, or a new one appears!

⏳ Race the clock across thousands of floors from various towers.
🏆 Compete for leaderboard times and watch replays of top runs.
❤️ Enjoying the game? Favoriting helps us grow!
📝 Updates happen every saturday!

🚫 No toxicity, exploiting, or glitch abusing. You will be banned.
☑️ All towers used with permission or from the creator marketplace. Contact us to request removal.
👤 Icon by @bambikilla9000 | Inspired by Eternal Towers of Hell

Read update changelogs and hangout in our Discord Server!
By awacrylic
